Samsø is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing on indicators such as the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant therapy (Indicator 5) using data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) [^src1]. Samsø's specific data for Indicator 5 is included in the municipal breakdown on page 95, though its figures are largely masked with placeholders (e.g., "#") and zeros, reflecting the statistical limitations and privacy protections applied to municipalities with very small patient cohorts [^src1].
